name: Oil Slick Iridescence
description: Nanometre-scale thin-film interference: film thickness is expressed in real nanometres (120–900 nm), the incidence angle comes from the height field's own gradient, the in-film angle follows Snell's law, and the two reflected beams combine with Fresnel weighting plus the pi phase step at the external interface. Curl-noise flow banded by the FFT transports the film; pointer and bounded click ring waves deform its surface.

updatedParams.name: Film Thickness
updatedParams.description: Base film thickness, 120–900 nm; bass swells it by up to 55%.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Rate the height field creeps under the curl transport.

updatedParams.name: Blend
updatedParams.description: Mix of the slick over the source plate.
